02 / FOUR STEPS

Guide the beginner before ranking

1. Your backgroundDegree, graduation, industry years, and research years.
2. What interests youRole families that make the search concrete.
3. What you've triedProject skills and visible evidence to build.
4. Your preferencesWorkplace, states, relocation, and learning priority.

The profile is optional and remembered only on this device when opted in.

06 / METHOD

Evidence with clear limits

  • Fresh official ATS or company-career sources
  • Earlier career/26fall data was discovery only and Bay Area LLM-biased
  • AI-assisted extraction plus agent review; not human verification
  • Missing data stays unknown; no applicant notes imported
  • No ML prediction or success-odds claim
  • Only 23 of 224 postings disclose annual base salary
